endpoint.title: Entur geocoder base URL
endpoint.description: Base URL of the Entur geocoder API. Defaults to the public Entur endpoint.

clientName.title: ET-Client-Name
clientName.description: Client identifier sent to Entur. Entur recommends the format "company-application".

boundaryCountry.title: Boundary country
boundaryCountry.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country filter applied to Entur autocomplete/search requests. Defaults to NOR.

multiModal.title: Multimodal stop behavior
multiModal.description: Whether Entur should return multimodal parent stops, child stops, or both.
